title: The sum of squared binomial coefficients is the central binomial coefficient
statement: For every natural n, the sum over all integers k of C(n,k)^2 equals C(2n,n). The summand vanishes outside 0 <= k <= n.

formal.statement:
(define-hyperterm F (* (^ (gamma (+ n 1)) 2) (/ 1 (^ (gamma (+ k 1)) 2)) (/ 1 (^ (gamma (+ (- n k) 1)) 2))))
(define-hyperterm T (* (gamma (+ (* 2 n) 1)) (/ 1 (gamma (+ n 1))) (/ 1 (gamma (+ n 1)))))
(assert (forall ((n Int)) (=> (>= n 0) (= (sum ((k Int)) F) T))))

evidence.supports: the creative-telescoping certificate, replayed by a checker that shares no code with the search that produced it
checkers: telescoping_check::confirm_ratios (shift ratios against exact bignum factorials)
telescoping_check::confirm_telescoping (pointwise identity and summed recurrence, exact bignum)
evidence.notes: Certificate: order 1, recurrence coefficients a_0 = 4n + 2, a_1 = -(n + 1) (i.e. (n+1)*S(n+1) = (4n+2)*S(n)), R(n,k) = k^2*(3n + 3 - 2k) / (n - k + 1)^2. Closed form C(2n,n) verified to satisfy the same recurrence; base case S(0) = 1 = C(0,0) checked by exact summation; leading coefficient -(n+1) has its only integer zero at n = -1, below the base, so the recurrence runs forward from n = 0.

evidence.supports: the serialised certificate itself, re-checked from the committed file with no search run
checkers: telescoping_json::from_json (exact [numerator, denominator] rationals; decimals, a foreign format tag and a truncated file are all refused)
telescoping_check::check_closed_form / check_closed_form_symbolic over the parsed closed form, where one is claimed
evidence.notes: This row exists so the fact rests on an ARTIFACT rather than on re-running the producer. The sweep reads every committed certificate, parses it, and hands it to the independent checker; nothing in that path calls the search. Tamper controls in the same file: a certificate numerator edited by one, a recurrence coefficient edited by one, and a certificate re-pointed at a neighbouring file's summand are each rejected, and a truncated / foreign-format / decimal-bearing file is refused by the reader before the checker sees it.

notes: Established on the `cas-certificate` route: an untrusted linear-algebra search (axeyum_cas::telescoping::zeilberger) produced the certificate, and axeyum_cas::telescoping_check verified it with its own shift-ratio derivation, its own fraction arithmetic, and a cross-check of both against exact bignum factorial evaluation of the summand. The checker rejects perturbed certificates -- see the tamper controls in the same test file (P+1, 2P, Q+k, a wrong recurrence constant, a degree bump in a_j, a zeroed recurrence, a certificate re-pointed at a different summand, a clipped summation window, and two wrong closed forms are all rejected).
